selected_evidence.summary: The unit is enabled and active; its heartbeat advanced while the same PID remained running.
The live mount namespace shows the root filesystem read-only and /var/lib/inventory writable. Worker probes against /etc, /var/tmp, and /root were denied before and after reboot.
The live worker reports NoNewPrivs=1 with permitted, effective, and ambient capability sets all zero.

Captured a healthy pre-restart baseline and boot ID, received safe-reboot scheduling acknowledgement, observed the boot ID change from a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3 to 35e4f295-74ef-4f4b-88d3-510145280875, then verified the service active with retained start count and advancing heartbeat.

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/libexec
sudo tee /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
state=/var/lib/inventory
checks="$state/sandbox-checks"
: > "$checks"
for target in /etc/inventory-worker-write-test /var/tmp/inventory-worker-write-test /root/inventory-worker-write-test; do
    if : > "$target" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$target"
        printf 'UNEXPECTED_WRITE %s\n' "$target" >> "$checks"
        exit 1
    else
        printf 'DENIED %s\n' "$target" >> "$checks"
    fi
done
awk '/^(NoNewPrivs|CapEff):/ { print }' /proc/self/status >> "$checks"
starts=0
if [ -r "$state/start-count" ]; then
    starts=$(cat "$state/start-count")
fi
starts=$((starts + 1))
printf '%s\n' "$starts" > "$state/start-count"
while :; do
    tmp="$state/heartbeat.$$.tmp"
    printf 'node=%s pid=%s start_count=%s time=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$$" "$starts" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$state/heartbeat"
    sleep 5
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_UNIT'

[Install]
